gaushala.hero.title: Our Gaushala
gaushala.hero.subtitle: Sacred cow protection and care - preserving Sanatan Dharma values
gaushala.dharma.title: Gaushala & Dharma Seva
gaushala.dharma.intro: Cow protection and Gaushala Seva form an essential part of the Ashram's mission. The organization promotes traditional values of cow care and preservation as described in Sanatan scriptures. The cow holds a revered place in Hindu tradition, symbolizing purity, nourishment, and divine grace.
gaushala.dharma.protection.title: Cow Protection
gaushala.dharma.protection.desc: Providing shelter, care, and protection to cows following traditional Vedic principles
gaushala.dharma.feed.title: Nutritious Feed
gaushala.dharma.feed.desc: Ensuring quality nutrition and natural fodder for the well-being of our cows
gaushala.dharma.medical.title: Medical Care
gaushala.dharma.medical.desc: Regular health checkups and veterinary care to maintain the health of our cattle
gaushala.dharma.opportunities.title: Gau Seva Opportunities
gaushala.dharma.opportunities.desc: Devotees can participate in cow service as part of their spiritual practice
gaushala.importance.title: Importance of Gau Seva
gaushala.importance.spiritual.title: Spiritual Significance
gaushala.importance.spiritual.desc: In Sanatan Dharma, the cow is revered as Gau Mata - the sacred mother who nourishes all
gaushala.importance.merit.title: Divine Merit
gaushala.importance.merit.desc: Serving and protecting cows is considered one of the highest forms of dharmic service
gaushala.importance.resources.title: Natural Resources
gaushala.importance.resources.desc: Cow products like milk, ghee, and organic manure are used in traditional ceremonies
gaushala.importance.heritage.title: Cultural Heritage
gaushala.importance.heritage.desc: Maintaining the ancient tradition of cow protection for future generations
gaushala.importance.sustainable.title: Sustainable Living
gaushala.importance.sustainable.desc: Promoting eco-friendly and sustainable agricultural practices
gaushala.importance.compassion.title: Compassion
gaushala.importance.compassion.desc: Teaching values of kindness and care for all living beings
gaushala.maharaj.heading: Maharaj ji with
gaushala.maharaj.desc: Our revered Mahanth Swami Shri Avdheshkumar Das Ji Maharaj personally oversees the care and protection of our sacred cows. His dedication to Gau Seva exemplifies the importance of cow protection in Sanatan Dharma.
gaushala.contribute.title: How You Can Contribute
gaushala.contribute.intro: Our Gaushala welcomes support from devotees who wish to participate in this sacred service. You can contribute through:
gaushala.contribute.fodder.title: 🍃 Fodder Donation
gaushala.contribute.fodder.desc: Support our cows by donating fodder and nutritious feed
gaushala.contribute.financial.title: 💰 Financial Support
gaushala.contribute.financial.desc: Contribute to the maintenance and care of our Gaushala
gaushala.contribute.volunteer.title: 🙌 Volunteer Service
gaushala.contribute.volunteer.desc: Participate in daily care and Gau Seva activities
gaushala.cta.title: Support Our Gaushala
gaushala.cta.desc: Join us in this sacred service of cow protection and preservation of Dharmic values
